Required if purpose != 'vlan-only': ip_subnet (CIDR, e.g. '192.168.1.0/24'). Required if purpose == 'vlan-only': vlan (int 1-4094). Optional: vlan_enabled, vlan, dhcpd_enabled, dhcpd_start, dhcpd_stop, dhcpd_leasetime, domain_name, enabled, network_isolation_enabled, upnp_lan_enabled, firewall_zone_id (V2 firewall-zone ID from unifi_list_firewall_zones; do not pass Integration API UUIDs).
